messages:
Samir: Quick follow-up from the postmortem for the KV-cache eviction incident (ENGOPS-1540). Need owners & timelines for remediation items. I sketched assignments below — please confirm or reassign by EOD Friday.

Maria: Thanks — assigning owners where I can. A few need infra input. @Kevin can you take ENGOPS-1543 (test harness + load repro)?

Kevin: I can take ENGOPS-1543. ETA 2w. I'll split out a subtask ENGOPS-1543A for the load test and link it.

Tara: I'll own stabilizing alert thresholds (ENGOPS-1544). ETA 1w. Will pair with @Kevin to align on signal shapes.

Samir: Two asks: 1) define RACI for rollout (who approves changes vs who implements), 2) pick a rotation steward for 90d to monitor regressions. Proposal: Tara wk1, Maria wk2, Kevin wk3 rotating. Thoughts?

Maria: Rotation sounds fine. Can we add oncall to the notification loop? @ops-bot can you add the rotation to the shared calendar and post reminders?

ops-bot: ✅ Added provisional steward rotation to #oncall-calendar. Weekly reminder scheduled. Will ping channel at 09:00 PT each Monday.

Kevin: Flagging recurring pattern — eviction spikes during bulk ingest windows (see logs around 03/10). I'll add load profile to ENGOPS-1543A and attach sample traces.

Samir: Please post PRs as drafts so we can link reviews in the postmortem doc. Also link the JIRA tickets here once created.

Maria: Draft table below — please comment inline or edit the ticket fields. I'll create the parent ticket if folks are OK.
```
Ticket        | Owner  | RACI        | Due
ENGOPS-1543   | Kevin  | R:Kevin, A:Samir, C:Infra, I:PM | 2024-11-08
ENGOPS-1543A  | Kevin  | R:Kevin, A:Samir, C:QA, I:PM      | 2024-11-15
ENGOPS-1544   | Tara   | R:Tara,  A:Maria, C:Observability | 2024-11-01
ENGOPS-1545   | Maria  | R:Maria, A:Samir, C:Security     | 2024-11-10
```

Kevin: I'll create ENGOPS-1543 and ENGOPS-1543A now: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/ENGOPS-1543

jira-bot: Ticket ENGOPS-1543 created by Kevin. https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/ENGOPS-1543

Tara: If anyone will be OOO during a due window, set the 'steward' field on the ticket so we have a clear handoff. Also suggest weekly 15m sync until first rollout.

Samir: Agreed. Booking a recurring 15m sync — invites sent. We'll review progress and unblock cross-team dependencies. If anything slips, escalate here and tag @Samir and @Maria.

Maria: Confirmed — I'll update the postmortem doc with ticket links and the RACI table after ENGOPS-1543 is live. Thanks all :thumbsup: 

Kevin: Marking ENGOPS-1543 in progress, will post initial PR by end of next week.

ops-bot: Reminder set: ENGOPS follow-up check-in in 7 days.

Samir: Thanks — closing the action assignment thread for now. We'll monitor rotation handoffs and reopen if new regressions appear.
